name: Hill AFB
description: Home to the Ogden Air Logistics Complex and major aircraft maintenance for Air Force Materiel Command. Supports F-35, T-7A, and other critical programs. Largest single-site employer in Utah.

currentNotifications.title: T-7A and F-35 Campus Construction
currentNotifications.body: Groundbreaking and ongoing construction for new T-7A and F-35 facilities. Expect minor traffic impacts in east campus areas.

gates.name: South Gate Visitor Center

gates.notes: Day passes and visitor registration. Open on AFMC Family Days. Phone: 801-777-8631.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Dormitory Management (801-777-5218) for unaccompanied housing or Falcon Inn (801-777-3311) for temporary lodging. Family housing through Liberty Military Housing.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 75 FSS, M&FRC, and official Hill AFB sites for in-processing and community support.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit MPF within required timelines. Contact base lodging for after-hours arrivals.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC if no sponsor is assigned before departure.
